scripts.build: node scripts/protect-data.cjs && node scripts/build-sitemap.cjs && vite build && node scripts/build-sitemap.cjs && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs && node scripts/protect-data.cjs --post-build
scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('dist/server.cjs')||!fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')){console.log('Production build artifacts missing; running npm run build...');cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
